name: What is the process for window installation from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for window installation from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our window installation process begins with an initial consultation and measurement, followed by a detailed quote. Once approved, we order your custom windows. Upon arrival, we schedule the installation. On installation day, our team prepares the work area, carefully removes existing windows, and inspects the rough openings. New windows are then installed, leveled, and sealed to ensure airtightness and proper function. We complete interior and exterior finishing, clean the site, and conduct a final walkthrough with you to ensure satisfaction and demonstrate window operation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The window installation process involves consultation, measurement, quoting, ordering, removal of old windows, installation, sealing, finishing, and a final walkthrough.
